bash: cd /app && python3 -c "
import mujoco, numpy as np, time

model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
print('timestep:', model.opt.timestep)
print('nbody:', model.nbody)
print('njnt:', model.njnt)
print('ngeom:', model.ngeom)
print('nuser_jnt:', model.nuser_jnt)
print('nuser_geom:', model.nuser_geom)
print('nuser_tendon:', model.nuser_tendon)
print('nuser_sensor:', model.nuser_sensor)
print('nplugin:', model.nplugin)
print('nplugin_config:', model.nplugin_config)
print('nplugin_state:', model.nplugin_state)
print('nuserdata:', model.nuserdata)
print('nM:', model.nM)
print('nconmax:', model.opt.nconmax)
print('nstack:', model.opt.nstack)
print('nuserdata:', model.nuserdata)
print('nexclude:', model.nexclude)
print('nactuator:', model.nactuator)
print('nsensor:', model.nsensor)
print('nnumeric:', model.nnumeric)
print('nnumeric_size:', model.nnumeric_size)
print('nkey:', model.nkey)

# Check plugin info
for i in range(model.nplugin):
    print(f'plugin {i}: name={mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_PLUGIN, i)}')

# Check composite
data = mujoco.MjData(model)
seed = np.random.randint(0, 10000)
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
data.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=data.qpos.shape)
mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)

# Timing
nstep = int(2.0 / model.opt.timestep)
print(f'nstep: {nstep}')
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(nstep):
    mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
print(f'Reference time: {t1-t0:.4f}s')
"
